notes.title: patch v0.1.3
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

- Shift buttons are now able to click under Side Alerts
- Players will no longer get challenges while already in a challenge room
- Fixed bug where if challenged in Bot mode, player will face bot instead of challenged opponent
- Fixed bug where friends list would not update after leaving challenge mode

notes.title: Patch v0.1.1
notes.content:
Patch v0.1.1
- Timer in Challenge mode has been removed
- movement sounds have been removed if a player is Cloaked

Bug Fix
- Bind and Inhibit animation frames would linger when player was cloaked. Bind and Inhibit animations frames can no longer be seen by the opponent when player is Cloaked.
